Top 3 India stories today, Mon 26 Oct, from Hindustan Times:

Cyclone Arnab to intensify before landfall on Wed 28 Oct. Expected to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam. Red alerts are out for parts of Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.
Jamia protests continue after the student union election announcement. Elections are promised within 15 days of the union constitution being approved. Delhi Police detained several students.
Govt allows flex-fuel vehicles that run on up to E100 fuel. The change takes effect immediately. Regular petrol vehicles cannot use these blends without certification and changes.
